articles.title: Streets on fire as housing crisis prompts mass protests in Spain
articles.description: Another European country is facing a huge protest outbreak as citizens vent their frustration.

articles.title: Spain General Strike and Housing Riots Erupt in Madrid and Barcelona
articles.description: Spain experiences its first general strike in 14 years as protests over soaring rents turn violent in Madrid and Barcelona following the eviction of Maricarmen Abascal.

articles.title: Spain General Strike 2024 Housing Crisis Riots Madrid Barcelona
articles.description: Millions of Spanish workers participated in the first general strike in 14 years, marking a turning point in the housing crisis. Protests in Madrid and Barcelona escalated into violent riots following the eviction of pensioner Maricarmen Abascal.

articles.title: Riots erupt in Spain during workers 'general strike'
Fires erupt, storefronts smashed as massive strike sparks riots across Spain
articles.description: Unruly protesters set fires, smashed storefronts and launched fireworks at riot police across parts of Spain on Wednesday as a massive nationwide strike over soaring housing costs disrupted transportation and businesses.
